scientific_integrity: General spread/integral extremizers and the Petersen n=5 radius are known prior facts; only the n>=6 formula, equality types and sharp n=11 transition are claimed. The proof is self-contained, with a standalone finite checker used only for corroboration.
scientific_limitations: Only real one-Lipschitz functions on uniform-vertex unit-edge KG(n,2) for n>=6. Higher-uniformity Kneser graphs, weighted probabilities and equivalent unindexed literature are not resolved.
title: Sharp Lipschitz spread and the eleven-point phase transition on Kneser pair graphs
